title: Daniel 8 — The vision of the ram and the male goat, the little horn, and the 2300 evenings-mornings

translation.sourceText: Daniel — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Masoretic Text Hebrew per BHS Codex Leningradensis primary; DSS 4Q113 (Danielb) secondary where preserved; Old Greek + Theodotion-Greek tertiary, especially at v 9 (little-horn vs strong-horn) + v 14 (2300 / 2400 evenings-mornings divergence). Chapter 8 returns to Hebrew (the Aramaic core 2:4b–7:28 having ended). The vision is the most explicitly historicizable in Daniel: ram = Medo-Persia (named v 20); male goat = Greece/Yāwān (named v 21); the little horn = Antiochus IV Epiphanes per dominant scholarly consensus.

verdicts.reasoning: Aramaic-to-Hebrew transition correctly handled at 8:1 (text_lang reverts to 'he').
2300 evenings-mornings preserved as literal day-count; commentary correctly identifies Antiochene desecration period (Dec 167 - Dec 164 BCE).
'seal up the vision' preserved (cross-corpus to Dan 12 sealed-book + Rev 22:10 reversal).

paragraphs.text: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹשׁ לְמַלְכ֖וּת בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֣ר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ חָז֞וֹן נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל אַחֲרֵ֛י הַנִּרְאָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י בַּתְּחִלָּֽה׃
paragraphs.translit: bi-šnaṯ šālōš lə-malḵūṯ Bēlšaʾṣṣar ham-meleḵ ḥāzōn nirʾāh ʾēlay ʾănî Dāniyyēʾl ʾaḥărê han-nirʾāh ʾēlay bat-təḥillāh

i18n.en: In the third year of the reign of Belshazzar the king a vision appeared to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.

paragraphs.text: וָאֶרְאֶה֮ בֶּחָזוֹן֒ וַיְהִי֙ בִּרְאֹתִ֔י וַאֲנִי֙ בְּשׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַבִּירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵילָ֣ם הַמְּדִינָ֑ה וָאֶרְאֶה֙ בֶּֽחָז֔וֹן וַאֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי עַל־אוּבַ֥ל אוּלָֽי׃
paragraphs.translit: wā-ʾerʾeh be-ḥāzōn way-hî bi-rʾōṯî wa-ʾănî bə-Šūšan hab-bîrāh ʾăšer bə-ʿÊlām ham-məḏînāh wā-ʾerʾeh be-ḥāzōn wa-ʾănî hāyîṯî ʿal-ʾūḇal ʾŪlāy

i18n.en: And I saw in the vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was in Susa the citadel, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in the vision, and I was by the river Ulai.

paragraphs.text: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ וָאֶרְאֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֣ה ׀ אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֗ד עֹמֵ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֻבָ֖ל וְל֣וֹ קְרָנָ֑יִם וְהַקְּרָנַ֣יִם גְּבֹה֗וֹת וְהָאַחַת֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה מִן־הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית וְהַ֨גְּבֹהָ֔ה עֹלָ֖ה בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃
paragraphs.translit: wā-ʾeśśāʾ ʿênay wā-ʾerʾeh wə-hinnēh ʾayil ʾeḥāḏ ʿōmēḏ lip̄nê hā-ʾuḇāl wə-lō qərānāyim wə-haq-qərānayim gəḇōhōṯ wə-hā-ʾaḥaṯ gəḇōhāh min-haš-šēnîṯ wə-hag-gəḇōhāh ʿōlāh bā-ʾaḥărōnāh

i18n.en: And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns; and the two horns were high, but the one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

paragraphs.text: רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת־הָאַ֡יִל מְנַגֵּחַ֩ יָ֨מָּה וְצָפ֜וֹנָה וָנֶ֗גְבָּה וְכָל־חַיּוֹת֙ לֹֽא־יַֽעַמְד֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּ֖יל מִיָּד֑וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה כִרְצוֹנ֖וֹ וְהִגְדִּֽיל׃
paragraphs.translit: rāʾîṯî ʾeṯ-hā-ʾayil mə-naggēaḥ yāmmāh wə-ṣāp̄ōnāh wā-neḡbāh wə-ḵol-ḥayyōṯ lōʾ-yaʿamḏū lə-p̄ānāyw wə-ʾên maṣṣîl mî-yāḏō wə-ʿāśāh ḵi-rṣōnō wə-hiḡdîl

i18n.en: I saw the ram pushing westward and northward and southward; and no beasts could stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.

paragraphs.text: וַאֲנִ֣י ׀ הָיִ֣יתִי מֵבִ֗ין וְהִנֵּ֤ה צְפִיר־הָֽעִזִּים֙ בָּ֤א מִן־הַֽמַּעֲרָב֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כָל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין נוֹגֵ֖עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהַ֨צָּפִ֔יר קֶ֥רֶן חָז֖וּת בֵּ֥ין עֵינָֽיו׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾănî hāyîṯî mēḇîn wə-hinnēh ṣəp̄îr-hā-ʿizzîm bāʾ min-ham-maʿărāḇ ʿal-pənê ḵol-hā-ʾāreṣ wə-ʾên nōḡēaʿ bā-ʾāreṣ wə-haṣ-ṣāp̄îr qeren ḥāzūṯ bên ʿênāyw

i18n.en: And as I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the face of the whole earth, and did not touch the ground; and the goat had a conspicuous horn between his eyes.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּבֹ֗א עַד־הָאַ֙יִל֙ בַּ֣עַל הַקְּרָנַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתִי עֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י הָאֻבָ֑ל וַיָּ֥רָץ אֵלָ֖יו בַּחֲמַ֥ת כֹּחֽוֹ׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yāḇōʾ ʿaḏ-hā-ʾayil baʿal haq-qərānayim ʾăšer rāʾîṯî ʿōmēḏ lip̄nê hā-ʾuḇāl way-yāroṣ ʾēlāyw ba-ḥămaṯ kōḥō

i18n.en: And he came to the ram that had the two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran at him in the fury of his power.

paragraphs.text: וּרְאִיתִ֞יו מַגִּ֣יעַ ׀ אֵ֣צֶל הָאַ֗יִל וַיִּתְמַרְמַ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־הָאַ֔יִל וַיְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י קְרָנָ֔יו וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה כֹ֛חַ בָּאַ֖יִל לַעֲמֹ֣ד לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤הוּ אַ֙רְצָה֙ וַֽיִּרְמְסֵ֔הוּ וְלֹא־הָיָ֥ה מַצִּ֛יל לָאַ֖יִל מִיָּדֽוֹ׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-rəʾîṯîw maggîaʿ ʾēṣel hā-ʾayil way-yiṯmarmar ʾēlāyw way-yaḵ ʾeṯ-hā-ʾayil way-šabbēr ʾeṯ-šətê qərānāyw wə-lōʾ-hāyāh ḵōaḥ bā-ʾayil la-ʿămōḏ lə-p̄ānāyw way-yašlîḵēhū ʾarṣāh way-yirməsēhū wə-lōʾ-hāyāh maṣṣîl lā-ʾayil mî-yāḏō

i18n.en: And I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram and broke his two horns; and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground and trampled upon him; and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

paragraphs.text: וּצְפִ֥יר הָעִזִּ֖ים הִגְדִּ֣יל עַד־מְאֹ֑ד וּכְעָצְמ֗וֹ נִשְׁבְּרָה֙ הַקֶּ֣רֶן הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וַֽתַּעֲלֶ֜נָה חָז֤וּת אַרְבַּע֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ לְאַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֥וֹת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-ṣəp̄îr hā-ʿizzîm hiḡdîl ʿaḏ-məʾōḏ ū-ḵə-ʿoṣmō nišbərāh haq-qeren hag-gəḏōlāh wat-taʿălenāh ḥāzūṯ ʾarbaʿ taḥtêhā lə-ʾarbaʿ rūḥōṯ haš-šāmāyim

i18n.en: And the male goat magnified himself exceedingly; and when he was strong, the great horn was broken, and instead of it there came up four conspicuous horns toward the four winds of heaven.

paragraphs.text: וּמִן־הָאַחַ֣ת מֵהֶ֔ם יָצָ֥א קֶֽרֶן־אַחַ֖ת מִצְּעִירָ֑ה וַתִּגְדַּל־יֶ֛תֶר אֶל־הַנֶּ֥גֶב וְאֶל־הַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְאֶל־הַצֶּֽבִי׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-min-hā-ʾaḥaṯ mēhem yāṣāʾ qeren-ʾaḥaṯ miṣ-ṣəʿîrāh wat-tiḡdal-yeṯer ʾel-han-neḡeḇ wə-ʾel-ham-mizrāḥ wə-ʾel-haṣ-ṣeḇî

i18n.en: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which grew exceedingly great toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.

paragraphs.text: וַתִּגְדַּ֖ל עַד־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתַּפֵּ֥ל אַ֛רְצָה מִן־הַצָּבָ֥א וּמִן־הַכּוֹכָבִ֖ים וַֽתִּרְמְסֵֽם׃
paragraphs.translit: wat-tiḡdal ʿaḏ-ṣəḇāʾ haš-šāmāyim wat-tappēl ʾarṣāh min-haṣ-ṣāḇāʾ ū-min-hak-kōḵāḇîm wat-tirməsēm

i18n.en: And it grew great, even to the host of heaven; and some of the host and of the stars it cast down to the ground, and trampled upon them.

paragraphs.text: וְעַ֥ד שַֽׂר־הַצָּבָ֖א הִגְדִּ֑יל וּמִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ הרים הוּרַ֣ם הַתָּמִ֔יד וְהֻשְׁלַ֖ךְ מְכ֥וֹן מִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʿaḏ śar-haṣ-ṣāḇāʾ hiḡdîl ū-mim-mennū hūram hat-tāmîḏ wə-hušlaḵ məḵōn miqdāšō

i18n.en: Yea, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the host; and it took away from him the continual burnt-offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

paragraphs.text: וְצָבָ֛א תִּנָּתֵ֥ן עַל־הַתָּמִ֖יד בְּפָ֑שַׁע וְתַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ אֱמֶת֙ אַ֔רְצָה וְעָשְׂתָ֖ה וְהִצְלִֽיחָה׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ṣāḇāʾ tinnāṯēn ʿal-hat-tāmîḏ bə-p̄āšaʿ wə-ṯašlēḵ ʾĕmeṯ ʾarṣāh wə-ʿāśə-ṯāh wə-hiṣlîḥāh

i18n.en: And the host was given over to it together with the continual burnt-offering through transgression; and it cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.

paragraphs.text: וָאֶשְׁמְעָ֥ה אֶֽחָד־קָד֖וֹשׁ מְדַבֵּ֑ר וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֶחָ֨ד קָד֜וֹשׁ לַפַּֽלְמוֹנִ֣י הַֽמְדַבֵּ֗ר עַד־מָתַ֞י הֶחָז֤וֹן הַתָּמִיד֙ וְהַפֶּ֣שַׁע שֹׁמֵ֔ם תֵּ֛ת וְקֹ֥דֶשׁ וְצָבָ֖א מִרְמָֽס׃
paragraphs.translit: wā-ʾešməʿāh ʾeḥāḏ-qāḏōš mə-ḏabbēr way-yōmer ʾeḥāḏ qāḏōš lap-palmōnî ham-məḏabbēr ʿaḏ-māṯay he-ḥāzōn hat-tāmîḏ wə-hap-pešaʿ šōmēm tēṯ wə-qōḏeš wə-ṣāḇāʾ mirmās

i18n.en: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, "How long shall be the vision concerning the continual burnt-offering, and the transgression that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?"

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י עַ֚ד עֶ֣רֶב בֹּ֔קֶר אַלְפַּ֖יִם וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וְנִצְדַּ֖ק קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yōmer ʾēlay ʿaḏ ʿereḇ bōqer ʾalpayim ū-šəlōš mēʾōṯ wə-niṣdaq qōḏeš

i18n.en: And he said to me, "Unto two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings; then shall the sanctuary be restored to its right state."

paragraphs.commentary: **2300 EVENINGS-MORNINGS** — the calendrical-arithmetic of the Antiochene desecration period. Cross-corpus to 1 Macc 1:54 (the abomination set up 15 Chislev 167 BCE) + 1 Macc 4:52 (the rededication 25 Chislev 164 BCE). The 2300 figure preserves a number consistent with the historical 3-year + 2-month period of desecration (Collins 1993). Translation preserves the literal '2300 evenings-mornings' without harmonization.

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֗י בִּרְאֹתִ֛י אֲנִ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל אֶת־הֶחָז֑וֹן וָאֲבַקְשָׁ֣ה בִינָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד לְנֶגְדִּ֖י כְּמַרְאֵה־גָֽבֶר׃
paragraphs.translit: way-hî bi-rʾōṯî ʾănî Dāniyyēʾl ʾeṯ-he-ḥāzōn wā-ʾăḇaqšāh ḇînāh wə-hinnēh ʿōmēḏ lə-neḡdî kə-marʾēh-ḡāḇer

i18n.en: And it came to pass, when I, Daniel, had seen the vision, that I sought to understand it; and behold, there stood before me one having the appearance of a man.

paragraphs.text: וָאֶשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹל־אָדָ֖ם בֵּ֣ין אוּלָ֑י וַיִּקְרָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר גַּבְרִיאֵ֕ל הָבֵ֥ן לְהַלָּ֖ז אֶת־הַמַּרְאֶֽה׃
paragraphs.translit: wā-ʾešmaʿ qōl-ʾāḏām bên ʾŪlāy way-yiqrāʾ way-yōmar Gaḇrîʾēl hāḇēn lə-hallāz ʾeṯ-ham-marʾeh

i18n.en: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called and said, "Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision."

paragraphs.text: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֵ֣צֶל עָמְדִ֔י וּבְבֹא֣וֹ נִבְעַ֔תִּי וָאֶפְּלָ֖ה עַל־פָּנָ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ הָבֵ֣ן בֶּן־אָדָ֔ם כִּ֖י לְעֶת־קֵ֥ץ הֶחָזֽוֹן׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yāḇōʾ ʾēṣel ʿomdî ū-ḇə-ḇōʾō niḇʿattî wā-ʾeppəlāh ʿal-pānāy way-yōmer ʾēlay hāḇēn ben-ʾāḏām kî lə-ʿeṯ-qēṣ he-ḥāzōn

i18n.en: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell upon my face; but he said to me, "Understand, O son of man; for the vision is for the time of the end."

paragraphs.text: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י נִרְדַּ֥מְתִּי עַל־פָּנַ֖י אָ֑רְצָה וַיִּ֨גַּע־בִּ֔י וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֖נִי עַל־עָמְדִֽי׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-ḇə-ḏabbərō ʿimmî nirdamtî ʿal-pānay ʾārṣāh way-yiggaʿ-bî way-yaʿămîḏēnî ʿal-ʿomdî

i18n.en: And as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me, and set me upright.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִנְנִ֣י מוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֔ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַזָּ֑עַם כִּ֖י לְמוֹעֵ֥ד קֵֽץ׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yōmer hinənî mōḏîʿăḵā ʾēṯ ʾăšer-yihyeh bə-ʾaḥărîṯ haz-zāʿam kî lə-mōʿēḏ qēṣ

i18n.en: And he said, "Behold, I will make you know what shall be in the latter end of the indignation; for it belongs to the appointed time of the end.

paragraphs.text: הָאַ֥יִל אֲשֶׁר־רָאִ֖יתָ בַּ֣עַל הַקְּרָנָ֑יִם מַלְכֵ֖י מָדַ֥י וּפָרָֽס׃
paragraphs.translit: hā-ʾayil ʾăšer-rāʾîṯā baʿal haq-qərānāyim malḵê Māḏay ū-P̄ārās

i18n.en: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.

paragraphs.text: וְהַצָּפִ֥יר הַשָּׂעִ֖יר מֶ֣לֶךְ יָוָ֑ן וְהַקֶּ֤רֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּין־עֵינָ֔יו ה֖וּא הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-haṣ-ṣāp̄îr haś-śāʿîr meleḵ Yāwān wə-haq-qeren hag-gəḏōlāh ʾăšer bên-ʿênāyw hūʾ ham-meleḵ hā-rîšōn

i18n.en: And the rough male goat is the king of Greece; and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

paragraphs.text: וְהַ֨נִּשְׁבֶּ֔רֶת וַתַּֽעֲמֹ֥דְנָה אַרְבַּ֖ע תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ אַרְבַּ֧ע מַלְכֻי֛וֹת מִגּ֥וֹי יַעֲמֹ֖דְנָה וְלֹ֥א בְכֹחֽוֹ׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-han-nišbereṯ wat-taʿămōḏnāh ʾarbaʿ taḥtêhā ʾarbaʿ malḵuyōṯ mig-gōy yaʿămōḏnāh wə-lōʾ ḇə-ḵōḥō

i18n.en: And as for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.

paragraphs.text: וּֽבְאַחֲרִית֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ם כְּהָתֵ֖ם הַפֹּשְׁעִ֑ים יַעֲמֹ֛ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עַז־פָּנִ֖ים וּמֵבִ֥ין חִידֽוֹת׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-ḇə-ʾaḥărîṯ malḵūṯām kə-hāṯēm hap-pōšəʿîm yaʿămōḏ meleḵ ʿaz-pānîm ū-mēḇîn ḥîḏōṯ

i18n.en: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

paragraphs.text: וְעָצַ֤ם כֹּחוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א בְכֹח֔וֹ וְנִפְלָא֥וֹת יַשְׁחִ֖ית וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְהִשְׁחִ֥ית עֲצוּמִ֖ים וְעַם־קְדֹשִֽׁים׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʿāṣam kōḥō wə-lōʾ ḇə-ḵōḥō wə-nip̄lāʾōṯ yašḥîṯ wə-hiṣlîaḥ wə-ʿāśāh wə-hišḥîṯ ʿăṣūmîm wə-ʿam-qəḏōšîm

i18n.en: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power; and he shall destroy wondrously, and shall prosper and do his pleasure; and he shall destroy the mighty ones and the people of the holy ones.

paragraphs.text: וְעַל־שִׂכְל֗וֹ וְהִצְלִ֤יחַ מִרְמָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וּבִלְבָב֣וֹ יַגְדִּ֔יל וּבְשַׁלְוָ֖ה יַשְׁחִ֣ית רַבִּ֑ים וְעַ֤ל־שַׂר־שָׂרִים֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וּבְאֶ֥פֶס יָ֖ד יִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʿal-śiḵlō wə-hiṣlîaḥ mirmāh bə-yāḏō ū-ḇi-lḇāḇō yaḡdîl ū-ḇə-šalwāh yašḥîṯ rabbîm wə-ʿal-śar-śārîm yaʿămōḏ ū-ḇə-ʾep̄es yāḏ yiššāḇēr

i18n.en: And through his cunning he shall cause deceit to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and in security shall he destroy many; he shall also stand up against the prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

paragraphs.text: וּמַרְאֵ֨ה הָעֶ֧רֶב וְהַבֹּ֛קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱמַ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת ה֑וּא וְאַתָּה֙ סְתֹ֣ם הֶֽחָז֔וֹן כִּ֖י לְיָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-marʾēh hā-ʿereḇ wə-hab-bōqer ʾăšer neʾĕmar ʾĕmeṯ hūʾ wə-ʾattāh səṯōm he-ḥāzōn kî lə-yāmîm rabbîm

i18n.en: And the vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true; but you shall seal up the vision, for it belongs to many days to come.

paragraphs.text: וַאֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֗אל נִהְיֵ֤יתִי וְנֶֽחֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ יָמִ֔ים וָאָק֕וּם וָאֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וָאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם עַל־הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין מֵבִֽין׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾănî Dāniyyēʾl nihyêṯî wə-neḥĕlêṯî yāmîm wā-ʾāqūm wā-ʾeʿĕśeh ʾeṯ-məleʾḵeṯ ham-meleḵ wā-ʾeštōmēm ʿal-ham-marʾeh wə-ʾên mēḇîn

i18n.en: And I, Daniel, was overcome, and was sick certain days; then I rose up, and did the king's business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.
